Floating Bubble

Open a small floating panel that stays on top of any window — including PowerPoint in full-screen presentation mode. Give points or pick a random student without ever leaving your slides.

Works in Chrome and Edge (desktop). The bubble uses your currently active class, so switch to the right class before opening it. Tap the arrow on the bubble to tuck it away to a slim bar while you teach, and tap again to bring the buttons back.

Allow microphone access to monitor classroom noise level
